response.query: Which dynamic demand models (quasi-dynamic BLP, inventory-aware choice, or state-dependent random coefficients) most credibly capture pricing expectations and cost pass-through to shocks?
response.answer: State-dependent random coefficients models most credibly capture pricing expectations and cost pass-through to shocks. Quasi-dynamic BLP and inventory-aware choice models also address these aspects but to a lesser extent.
